payload.expected_effect: target-a will be relaunched with the reviewed serving profile; its chat_template, tool_call_parser, and tool_parser_plugin will match the reviewed configuration. The worker is taken out of rotation during restart, then returned to service. The visible tool-call canary should then produce valid tool‑
payload.reasoning: target-a is the only resource with an abnormality: its configuration has drifted from the reviewed profile, causing the visible tool-call canary to fail (0 structured tool calls). target-b is healthy with matching config and successful tool-call generation. The apply-serving-profile move will relaunch target-a with the reviewed profile (qwen25-coder-7b.tools-template), aligning its chat_template, tool_call_parser, and tool_parser_plugin with the expected values. No other moves are needed because target-b has no fault, and there is no evidence of network_path, crashed, or overloaded conditions.
